articles.title: Bolton Pleads Guilty: A Top Official's Secret Papers Case
articles.summary: John Bolton, former national security adviser to President Trump, pleaded guilty to keeping classified documents. He faces up to 5 years in prison and a $2.25 million fine. His case stands apart from other politically charged prosecutions.

articles.title: World Cup Ticket Chaos: Resale Failures Leave Fans Stranded
articles.summary: Fans who bought resale tickets on StubHub and other sites missed World Cup games when tickets never arrived. Some drove hours or flew from other countries, only to watch from home. StubHub blames FIFA's app; FIFA says only its platform is guaranteed.

articles.title: Royal Finances: King Charles Publishes Tax Bill, But Questions Remain
articles.summary: King Charles III revealed he paid £12.9 million in taxes, a first for a monarch. The Sovereign Grant is dropping to £99.9 million, but critics say transparency is still limited — with no breakdown of income or expenses.
